mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet-activating factor and has antiplatelet/anticoagulant properties, which may potentiate furosemide-induced volume depletion and increase bleeding risk; additionally, both agents may affect renal function and electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor patients for signs of bleeding, bruising, or excessive fluid loss; counsel patients on concurrent use risks and ensure regular monitoring of renal function and electrolytes.
